claims.text: Our model outperforms previous extractive and abstractive models on ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and METEOR scores.
The improvements over the Baseline model indicate that our model's combination of local and global contextual information enhances performance.
The performance significantly improves with the addition of local topic information, especially for long documents.
